from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1:
                regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    sources = []
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        if any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
            sources.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if sources:
        sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = sources[0]
        pattern = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
        for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
            if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == (sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1):
                continue
            if r1-r0 == len(pattern) and c1-c0 == len(pattern[0]) and all(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
                for dr in range(r1-r0):
                    for dc in range(c1-c0):
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
prog_path=program_dir/'task-6fc09535.py'
prog_path.write_text(code)
